verses: Pak hai woh Allah Taalaa jo apney banday ko raat hi raat mein masjid haram say masjid Aqsa tak ley gaya jiss kay aas pass hum ney barkat dey rakhi hai, uss liye kay hum ussay apni qudrat kay baaz namoney dikhayen, yaqeenan Allah Taalaa hi khoob sunnay dekhney wala hai
Hum ney Musa ko kitab di aur ussay bani israeel kay liye hidayat bana diya kay tum meray siwa kissi ko apna kaarsaaz na banana
Aey unn logon ki aulad! jinhen hum ney Nooh kay sath sawar kerdiya tha, woh humara bara hi shukar-guzar bandah tha
Hum ney bani israeel kay liye unn ki kitab mein saaf faisla kerdiya tha kay tum zamin mein doobara fasad barpa kero gay aur tum bari zabardast ziyadtiyan kero gay

Unn dono wadon mein say pehlay kay aatay hi hum ney tumharay muqabla per apney banday bhej diye jo baray hi larakay thay. Pus woh tumharay gharon kay andar tak phel gaye aur Allah ka yeh wada poora hona hi tha
Phir hum ney unn per tumhara ghalba dey ker tumharay din pheray aur maal aur aulad say tumhari madad ki aur tumhen baray juthay wala bana diya

Agar tum ney achay kaam kiye to khud apney hi faeedah kay liye, aur agar tum ney buraiyan kin to bhi apney hi liye, phir jab doosray waday ka waqt aaya (to hum ney doosray bandon ko bhej diya takay) woh tumharay chehray bigar den aur pehli dafa ki tarah phir ussi masjid mein ghuss jayen. Aur jiss jiss cheez per qaboo payen tor phor ker jarr say ukhar den
Umeed hai kay tumhara rab tum per reham keray. Haan agar tum phir bhi o hi kerney lagay to hum bhi doobara aisa hi keren gay aur hum ney munkiron ka qaid khana jahannum ko bana rakha hai
Yaqeenan yeh Quran woh raasta dikhata hai jo boht hi seedha hai aur eman walon ko jo nek aemaal kertay hain uss baat ki khushkhabri deta hai kay unn kay liye boht bara ajar hai
Aur yeh kay jo log aakhirat per yaqeen nahi rakhtay unn kay liye hum ney dard-naak azab tayyar ker rakha hai
Aur insan buraee ki duayen mangney lagta hai bilkul uss ki apni bhalaee ki dua ki tarah, insan hai hi bara jald baaz

Hum ney raat aur din ko apni qudrat ki nishaniyan banaee hain, raat ki nishani ko to hum ney noor kerdiya hai aur din ki nishani ko roshan banaya hai takay tum apney rab ka fazal talash ker sako aur uss liye bhi kay barson ka shumar aur hisab maloom ker sako aur her her cheez ko hum ney khoob tafseel say biyan farma diya hai
Hum ney her insan ki buraee bhalaee ko uss kay galay laga diya hai aur baroz qayamat hum uss kay samney uss ka nama aemaal nikalen gay jissay woh apney upper khulla hua paley ga
Ley! khud hi apni kitab aap parh ley. Aaj to to aap hi apna khud hisab lenay ko kafi hai

Jo raah raast hasil kerley woh khud apney hi bhalay kay liye raah yafta hota hai aur jo bhatak jaye uss ka bojh ussi kay upper hai, koi bojh wala kissi aur ka bojh apney upper na laaday ga aur humari sunnat nahi kay rasool bhejney say pehlay hi azab kerney lagen

Aur jab hum kissi basti ki halakat ka iradah ker letay hain to o haan kay khushal logon ko (kuch) hukum detay hain aur woh uss basti mein khulli na-farmani kerney lagtay hain to unn per (azab ki) baat sabit hojati hai phir hum ussay tabah o barbaad ker detay hain
Hum ney Nooh kay baad bhi boht si qomen halak kin aur tera rab apney bandon kay gunahon say kafi khabardaar aur khoob dekhney bhalney wala hai

Jiss ka iradah sirf uss jaldi wali duniya (fori faeedah) ka hi ho ussay hum yahan jiss qadar jiss kay liye chahayen sirdast detay hain bil-aakhir uss kay liye hum jahannum muqarrar ker detay hain jahan woh buray halon dhutkara hua dakhil hoga
Aur jiss ka iradah aakhirat ka ho aur jaisi koshish uss kay liye honi chahaye, woh kerta bhi ho aur woh ba-emaan bhi ho, pus yehi log hain jin ki koshish ki Allah kay haan poori qadar ki jaye gi
Her aik ko hum ba-hum phonchaye jatay hain unhen bhi aur unhen bhi teray perwerdigar kay inamaat mein say. Teray perwerdigar ki bakhsish ruki hui nahi hai
Dekh ley kay unn mein aik ko aik per hum ney kiss tarah fazilat dey rakhi hai aur aakhirat to darjon mein aur bhi barh ker hai aur fazilat kay aitbaar say bhi boht bari hai
Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood na thehra kay aakhirish to buray halon kus ho ker beth rahey ga

Aur tera perwerdigar saaf saaf hukum dey chuka hai kay tum uss kay siwa kissi aur ki ibadat na kerna aur maa baap kay sath ehsan kerna. Agar teri mojoodgi mein unn mein say aik ya yeh dono burhapay ko phonch jayen to unn kay aagay uff tak na kehna, na unhen dant dapat kerna balkay)yeh unn kay sath adab o adab-o-ehtram say baat cheet kerna

Aur aajzi aur mohabbat kay sath unn kay samney tawazo ka bazoo pust rakhay rakhna aur dua kertay rehna kay aey meray perwerdigar! unn per wesa hi reham ker jaisa unhon ney meray bachpan mein meri perwerish ki hai
Jo kuch tumharay dilon mein hai ussay tumhara rab bakhoobi janta hai agar tum nek ho to woh to rujoo kerney walon ko bakhshney wala hai
Aur rishtay daron ka aur miskeenon aur musafiron ka haq ada kertay raho aur israaf aur beja kharach say bacho
Beja kharach kerney walay shetanon kay bhai hain. Aur shetan apney perwerdigar ka bara hi nashukra hai
Aur agar tujhay unn say mun pher lena paray apney rab ki uss rehmat ki justujoo mein, jiss ki to umeed rakhta hai to bhi tujhay chahaye kay umdagi aur narmi say unhen samjha dey
Apna hath apni gardan say bandha hua na rakh aur na ussay bilkul hi khol dey kay phir malamat kiya hua darmanda beth jaye
Yaqeenan tera rab jiss kay liye chahaye rozi kushadah ker deta hai aur jiss kay liye chahaye tang. Yaqeenan woh apney bandon say ba-khabar aur khoob dekhney wala hai
Aur muflisi kay khof say apni aulad ko na maar dalo, unn ko aur tum ko hum hi rozi detay hain. Yaqeenan unn ka qatal kerna kabeerah gunah hai
Khabardaar zinna kay qareeb bhi na phatakna kiyon kay woh bari bey-hayai hai aur boht hi buri raah hai

Aur kissi jaan ko jiss ka maarna Allah ney haram kerdiya hai hergiz na-haq qatal na kerna aur jo shakhs mazloom honey ki soorat mein maar dala jaye hum ney uss kay waris ko taqat dey rakhi hai pus ussay chahaye kay maar dalney mein ziyadti na keray be-shak woh madad kiya gaya hai

Aur yateem kay maal kay qareeb bhi na jao ba-juz uss tareeqa kay jo boht hi behtar ho, yahan tak kay woh apni balooghat ko phonch jaye aur waday pooray kero kyunkay qol o qarar ki baaz purs honey wali hai
Aur jab naapney lago to bhar por paymaney say naapo aur seedhi tarazoo say tola kero. Yehi behtar hai aur anjam kay lehaz say bhi boht acha hai
Jiss baat ki tujhay khabar hi na ho uss kay peechay mat parr. Kyunkay kaan aur aankh aur dil unn mein say her aik say pooch gooch ki janey wali hai
Aur zamin mein akar ker na chal kay na to zamin ko phaar sakta hai aur na lambai mein paharon ko phonch sakta hai
Unn sab kaamon ki buraee teray rab kay nazdeek (sakht) pasand hai

Yeh bhi munjmila uss wahee kay hai jo teri janib teray rab ney hikmat say utari hai to Allah kay sath kissi aur ko mabood na banana kay malamat khordah aur randa raand-e-dargah ho ker dozakh mein daal diya jaye
Kiya beton kay liye to Allah ney tumhen chant liya aur khud apney liye farishton ko larkiyan bana len? Be-shak tum boht bara bol bol rahey ho
Hum ney to uss Quran mein her her tarah biyan farma diya kay log samajh jayen lekin uss say unhen to nafrat hi barhti hai
Keh dijiye! kay agar Allah kay sath aur mabood bhi hotay jaisay kay yeh log kehtay hain to zaroor woh abb tak malik arsh ki janib raah dhoond nikaltay
Jo kuch yeh kehtay hain uss say woh pak aur bala-tar, boht door aur boht buland hai

Saton aasman aur zamin aur jo bhi unn mein hai ussi ki tasbeeh ker rahey hain. Aisi koi cheez nahi jo ussay pakeezgi aur tareef kay sath yaad na kerti ho. Haan yeh sahih hai kay tum uss ki tasbeeh samajh nahi saktay. Woh bara burdbaar aur bakhshney wala hai
To jab Quran parhta hai hum teray aur unn logon kay darmiyan jo aakhirat per yaqeen nahi rakhtay aik posheedah hijab daal detay hain

Aur unn kay dilon per hum ney parday daal diye hain kay woh ussay samjhen aur unn kay kanon mein bojh aur jab to sirf Allah hi ka zikar uss ki toheed kay sath, uss Quran mein kerta hai to woh roo-gardani kertay peeth pher ker bhaag kharay hotay hain

Jiss gharz say woh log ussay suntay hain unn (ki niyaton) say hum khoob aagah hain, jab yeh aap ki taraf kaan lagaye huye hotay hain tab bhi aur jab yeh mashwara kertay hain tab bhi jab kay yeh zalim kehtay hain kay tum uss ki tabeydaari mein lagay huye ho jin per jadoo kerdiya gaya hai
Dekhen to sahi, aap kay liye kiya kiya misalen biyan kertay hain, pus woh behak rahey hain. Abb to raah pana unn kay bus mein nahi raha
Unhon ney kaha kiya jab hum hadiyan aur (mitti ho ker) reza reza hojayen gay to kiya hum sir-e-no peda ker kay phir doobara utha ker kharay ker diye jayen gay
Jawab dijiye kay tum pathar bann jao ya loha

Ya koi aur aisi khulqat jo tumharay dilon mein boht hi sakht maloom ho, phir woh poochen kay kaun hai jo doobara humari zindagi lotaye? Aap jawab dey den kay o hi Allah jiss ney tumhen awwal baar peda kiya, uss per woh apney sir hila hila ker aap say daryaft keren gay kay acha yeh hai kab? To aap jawab dey den kay kiya ajab kay woh (sa’at) qareeb hi aan lagi ho
Jiss din woh tumhen bulaye ga tum uss ki tareef kertay huye tameel irshad kero gay aur guman kero gay kay tumhara rehna boht hi thora hai
Aur meray bandon say keh dijiye kay woh boht hi achi baat mun say nikala keren kyunkay shetan aapas mein fasad dalwata hai. Be-shak shetan insan ka khulla dushman hai

Tumhara rab tum say ba nisbat tumharay boht ziyadah jannay wala hai, woh agar chahaye to tum per reham kerdey ya agar woh chahaye tumhen azab dey. Hum ney aap ko unn ka zimmay daar thehra ker nahi bheja
Aasmano o zamin mein jo bhi hai aap ka rab sab ko bakhoobi janta hai. Hum ney baaz payghumbaron ko baaz per behtri aur bartari di hai aur Dawood ko Zaboor hum ney ata farmaee hai
Keh dijiye kay Allah kay siwa jinhen tum mabood samajh rahey ho unhen pukaro lekin na to woh tum say kissi takleef ko door saktay hain aur na badal saktay hain

Jinhen yeh log pukartay hain khud woh apney rab kay taqarrub ki justujoo mein rehtay hain kay unn mein say kaun ziyadah nazdeek hojaye woh khud uss ki rehmat ki umeed rakhtay aur uss kay azab say khofzada rehtay hain, (baat bhi yehi hai) kay teray rab ka azab darney ki cheez hi hai
Jitni bhi bastiyan hain hum qayamat kay din say pehlay pehlay ya to unhen halak kerdenay walay hain ya sakht tar saza denay walay hain. Yeh to kitab mein likha chuka hai

Humen nishanaat (mojzaat) kay nazil kerney say rok sirf ussi ki hai kay aglay log unhen jhutla chukay hain. Hum ney samoodiyon ko bator baseerat kay oontni di lekin unhon ney uss per zulm kiya hum to logon ko dhamkaney kay liye hi nishaniyan bhejtay hain

Aur yaad kero jab kay hum ney aap say farma diya kay aap kay rab ney logon ko gher liya hai. Jo roya (any royat) hum ney aap ko dikhaee thi woh logon kay liye saaf aazmaeesh hi thi aur ussi tarah woh darakht bhi jiss say Quran mein izhar nafrat kiya gaya hai. Hum unhen dara rahey hain lekin yeh unhen aur bari sirkashi mein barha raha hai
Jab hum ney farishton ko hukum diya kay Adam ko sajdah kero to Iblees kay siwa sab ney kiya, uss ney kaha kay kiya mein ussay sajdah keroon jissay tu ney mitti say peda kiya hai
Acha dekh ley ussay tu ney mujh per buzrugi to di hai, lekin agar mujhay bhi qayamat tak tu ney dheel di to mein uss ki aulad ko ba-juz boht thoray logon kay, apney bus mein kerloon ga
Irshad hua kay jaa unn mein say jo bhi tera tabeydaar hojaye ga to tum sab ki saza jahannum hai jo poora poora badla hai

Unn mein say to jissay bhi apni awaz say behka sakay behka ley aur unn per apney sawar aur piyaday charha laa aur unn kay maal aur aulad mein say apna bhi sajha laga aur unhen (jhootay) waday dey ley. Unn say jitney bhi waday shetan kay hotay hain sab kay sab sirasir fareb hain
Meray sachay bandon per tera koi qaboo aur bus nahi. Tera rab kaarsaazi kerney wala kafi hai
Tumhara perwerdigar woh hai jo tumharay liye darya mein kashtiyan chalata hai takay tum uss ka fazal talash kero. Woh tumharay upper boht hi meharban hai

Aur samandaron mein museebat phonchtay hi jinhen tum pukartay thay sab gumm hojatay hain sirf o hi Allah baqi reh jata hai. Phir jab woh tumhen khushki ki taraf bacha laata hai to tum mun pher letay ho aur insan bara hi nashukra hai
To kiya tum uss say khof hogaye ho kay tumhen khushki ki taraf (ley ker zamin) mein dhansa dey ya tum per pathron ki aandhi bhej dey. Phir tum apney liye kissi nigehbaan ko na sako

Kiya tum uss baat say khof hogaye ho kay Allah Taalaa phir tumhen doobara darya kay safar mein ley aaye aur tum per tez tund hawaon kay jhonkay bhej dey aur tumharay kufur kay baees tumhen dobo dey. Phir tum apney liye hum per uss ka dawa (peecha) kerney wala kissi ko na pao gay
Yaqeenan hum ney aulad Adam ko bari izzat di aur unhen khushki aur tari ki sawariyan den aur unhen pakeezah cheezon ki roziyan den aur apni boht si makhlooq per unhen fazilat ata farmaee

Jiss din hum her jamat ko uss kay paishwa samet bulayen gay. Phir jin ka bhi aemaal nama dayen hath mein dey diya gaya woh to shoq say apna nama aemaal parhney lagen gay aur dhagay kay barabar (zarra barabar) bhi zulm na kiye jayen gay
Aur jo koi uss jahaan mein andha raha, woh aakhirat mein bhi andha aur raastay say boht hi bhatka hua rahey ga
Yeh log aap ko uss wahee say jo hum ney aap per utari hai behkana chahatay kay aap uss kay siwa kuch aur hi humaray naam say gharr ghara len, tab to aap ko yeh log apna o li dost bana letay
Agar hum aap ko sabit qadam na rakhtay to boht mumkin tha kay unn ki taraf qadray qaleel maeel ho hi jatay
Phir to hum bhi aap ko dohra azab duniya ka kertay aur dohra hi maut ka, phir aap to apney liye humaray muqablay mein kissi ko madadgar bhi na patay
Yeh to aap kay qadam uss zamin say ukharaney hi lagay thay kay aap ko uss say nikal den. Phir yeh bhi aap kay baad boht hi kum thehar patay
Aisa hi dastoor unn ka tha jo aap say pehlay rasool hum ney bhejay aur aap humaray dastoor mein kabhi radd-o-badal na payen gay
Namaz ko qaeem keren aftab kay dhalney say ley ker raat ki tareeki tak aur fajar ka Quran parhna bhi yaqeenan fajar kay waqt ka Quran parhna hazir kiya gaya hai
Raat kay kuch hissay mein tahajjud ki namaz mein Quran ki tilawat keren yeh ziyadti aap kay liye hai unqareeb aap ka rab aap ko muqam muqam-e-mehmood mein khara keray ga
Aur dua kiya keren kay aey meray perwerdigar mujhay jahan ley jaa achi tarah ley jaa aur jahan say nikal achi tarah nikal aur meray liye apney pass say ghalba aur imdad muqarrar farma dey
Aur ailaan kerdey kay haq chuka aur na-haq nabood hogaya. Yaqeenan baatil tha bhi nabood honey wala
Yeh Quran jo hum nazil ker rahey hain mominon kay liye to sirasir shifa aur rehmat hai. Haan zalimon ko ba-juz nuksan kay aur koi ziyadti nahi hoti
Aur insan per jab hum apna inam kertay hain to woh mun mor leta hai aur kerwat badal leta hai aur jab ussay koi takleef phonchti hai to woh mayyus hojata hai
Keh dijiye! kay her shakhs apney tareeqa per aamil hai jo poori hidayat kay raastay per hain unhen tumhara rab hi bakhoobi jannay wala hai
Aur yeh log aap say rooh ki babat sawal kertay hain, aap jawab dey dijiye kay rooh meray rab kay hukum say hai aur tumhen boht hi kum ilm diya gaya hai
Aur agar hum chahayen to jo wahee aap ki taraf hum ney utari hai sab salb kerlen, phir aap ko uss kay liye humaray muqablay mein koi himayati mayassar na sakay
Siwaye aap kay rab ki rehmat kay, yaqeenan aap per uss ka bara hi fazal hai
Keh dijiye kay agar tamam insan aur kul jinnat mill ker uss Quran kay misil lana chahayen to unn sab say uss kay misil lana na-mumkin hai go woh (aapas mein) aik doosray kay madadgar bhi bann jayen
Hum ney to uss Quran mein logon kay samajhney kay liye her tarah say tamam misalen biyan kerdi hain, magar aksar log inkar say baaz nahi aatay
Unhon ney kaha kay hum aap per hergiz eman laney kay nahi ta-waqt-e-kay aap humaray liye zamin say koi chashma jari na ker den
Ya khud aap kay liye hi koi baagh ho khujooron aur angooron ka aur uss kay darmiyan aap boht si nehren jari ker dikhayen
Ya aap aasman ko hum per tukray tukray kerkay gira den jaisa kay aap ka guman hai ya aap khud Allah Taalaa ko aur farishton ko humaray samney khara keren

Ya aap kay apney liye koi soney ka ghar hojaye ya aap aasman per charh jayen aur hum to aap kay charh janey ka bhi uss waqt tak hergiz yaqeen nahi keren gay jab tak kay aap hum per koi kitab na utaar layen jissay hum khud parh len, aap jawab dey den kay mera perwerdigar pak hai mein to sirf aik insan hi hun jo rasool banaya gaya hun
Logon kay pass hidayat phonch chukney kay baad eman say rokney wali sirf yehi cheez rahi kay unhon ney kaha kiya Allah ney aik insan ko hi rasool bana ker bheja?
Aap keh den kay agar zamin mein farishtay chaltay phirtay aur rehtay bastay hotay to hum bhi unn kay pass kissi aasmani farishtay hi ko rasool bana ker bhejtay
Keh dijiye kay meray aur tumharay darmiyan Allah Taalaa ka gawah hona kafi hai. Woh apney bandon say khoob aagah aur bakhoobi dekhney wala hai

Allah jiss ki rehnumaee keray to woh hidayat yafta hai aur jissay woh raah say bhatka dey na-mumkin hai kay to uss ka madadgar uss kay siwa kissi aur ko paye, aisay logon ka hum baroz qayamat ondhay mun hashar keren gay, daran halanakay woh andhay, goongay aur behray hun gay, unn ka thikana jahannum hoga. Jab kabhi woh bujhney lagay gi hum unn per ussay aur bharka den gay
Yeh sab humari aayaton say kufur kerney aur uss kehney ka badla hai kay kiya jab hum hadiyan aur rezay rezay hojayen gay phir hum naee pedaeesh mein utha kharay kiye jayen gay?

Kiya unhon ney uss baat per nazar nahi ki kay jiss Allah ney aasman o zamin ko peda kiya hai woh unn jaison ki pedaeesh per poora qadir hai, ussi ney unn kay liye aik aisa waqt muqarrar ker rakha hai jo shak shuba)yeh say yaksar khali hai, lekin zalim log inkar kiye baghair rehtay hi nahi
Keh dijiye kay agar bil-farz tum meray rab ki rehmaton kay khazanon kay malik bann jatay to tum uss waqt bhi uss kay kharach hojaney kay khof say uss ko rokay rakhtay aur insan hai hi tang dil

Hum ney Musa ko no moajzzay bilkul saaf saaf ata farmaye, to khud hi bani israeel say pooch ley kay jab woh unn kay pass phonchay to Firaun bola kay aey Musa meray khayal mein to tujh per jadoo kerdiya gaya hai

Musa ney jawab diya kay yeh to tujhay ilm chuka hai kay aasman o zamin kay perwerdigar hi ney yeh moajzzay dikhaney, samjhaney ko nazil farmaye hain, aey Firaun! mein to samajh raha hun kay to yaqeenan barbaad o halak kiya gaya hai
Aakhir Firaun ney pukhta iradah ker liya kay unhen zamin say hi ukher dey to hum ney khud ussay aur uss kay tamam sathiyon ko gharq ker diya
Uss kay baad hum ney bani israeel say farma diya kay uss zamin per tum raho saho. Haan jab aakhirat ka wada aaye ga hum tum sab ko samet aur lapet ker ley aayen gay
Aur hum ney uss Quran ko haq kay sath utara aur yeh bhi haq kay sath itra. Hum ney aap ko sirf khushkhabri sunaney wala aur daraney wala bana ker bheja hai
Quran ko hum ney thora thora kerkay uss liye utara hai kay aap ussay ba mohlat logon ko sunayen aur hum ney khud bhi ussay ba-tadreej nazil farmaya
Keh dijiye! tum uss per eman lao ya na lao jinhen uss say pehlay ilm diya gaya hai unn kay pass to jab bhi uss ki tilawat ki jati hai to woh thoriyon kay bal sajdah mein gir partay hain
Aur kehtay hain kay humara rab pak hai, humaray rab ka wada bila-shak o shuba)yeh poora ho ker rehney wala hi hai
Woh apni thoriyon kay bal rotay huye sajdah mein gir partay hain aur yeh Quran unn ki aajzi aur khushoo aur khuzoo barha deta hai

Keh dijiye kay Allah ko Allah keh ker pukaro ya rehman keh ker, jiss naam say bhi pukaro tamam achay naam ussi kay hain. Na to to apni namaz boht buland awaz say parh aur na bilkul posheedah balkay)yeh uss kay darmiyan ka raasta talash kerley

Aur yeh keh dijiye kay tamam tareefen Allah hi kay liye hain jo na aulad rakhta hai na apni badshahat mein kissi ko shareek o sajhi rakhta hai aur na woh kamzor hai kay ussay kissi himayati ki zaroorat ho aur to uss ki poori poori baraee biyan kerta reh
